title: Yummy British Chinese Leaf Wrap
description: A rich, light dish featuring a combination of norther Irish and Chinese flavors in a wrap made from nuka-pickle seasoned kale leaves.
instructions: Wash and chop the kale leaves into strips.
Add nuka-pickle, salt, and olive oil to a small bowl. Mix well until evenly distributed.
Gently heat the mixed ingredients over low-medium heat for about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Transfer the heated mixture to a serving dish and let it cool down slightly.
Place the cooled vegetable dressing inside each kale leaf wrap.
Fold kale leaves into wraps and serve immediately.
